phrasings.literal: List every task whose status is open and whose priority is P0.
phrasings.short: open P0 tasks
phrasings.paraphrased: Which of the highest-priority P0 tasks are still sitting in the open state?

gold_query: MATCH (n:task) WHERE n.status = 'open' AND n.priority <= 0 RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §13 (P0 tasks on main: #261, #276, #277; no filler task has P0-P2) and SD §5.4-§5.5: all three are open on main (#276 is in progress only on lane/net). Gold query is std.find folded with kind=task, status=open, prio=..0.

phrasings.literal: Перечисли задачи в статусе open с меткой audio и приоритетом P0 или P1.
phrasings.short: открытые задачи с меткой audio, приоритет P0–P1
phrasings.paraphrased: Какие ещё не взятые в работу задачи с меткой audio имеют приоритет P1 или выше?

gold_query: MATCH (n:task) WHERE n.status = 'open' AND n.priority <= 1 AND 'audio' IN n.labels RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §5.4 and §13: the audio label is on #260-#267 only; open are #260-#266 (#267 frozen); P0/P1 among them: #260 (P1, the container), #261 (P0), #262 (P1), #263 (P1). Gold query is std.find folded.

phrasings.literal: Which open tasks have an owned-file pattern that lies under the src/net/ directory?
phrasings.short: open tasks owning files under src/net/
phrasings.paraphrased: Among tasks still in the open state, which ones claim ownership of paths in src/net/?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND any(g IN t.files_owned WHERE g STARTS WITH 'src/net/') RETURN t
notes: SD §5.3-§5.5: files_owned is set on #245, #246, #261, #262, #274 (src/net/ring*.rs), #275 (src/net/delta/**), #276 (src/net/tick.rs); #274-#276 are open on main; filler has no files_owned (SD §12.2).

phrasings.literal: Which unfinished tasks have a title beginning with 'Mixer' and no estimate recorded?
phrasings.short: unfinished tasks titled 'Mixer...' lacking an estimate
phrasings.paraphrased: Of the tasks not yet done or cancelled whose names start with 'Mixer', which still lack an effort estimate?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.title STARTS WITH 'Mixer' AND t.unfinished AND t.estimate IS NULL RETURN t
notes: SD §5.4: task titles starting with 'Mixer' are #261 (estimate 8), #264 and #265 (no estimate), all open; #236, #237 are notes and #268 a doc; filler titles start with 'Backlog item' (SD §12.2).

phrasings.literal: Which open tasks labelled assets have the word 'importer' in their title, ignoring letter case?
phrasings.short: open assets tasks with 'importer' in title, any case
phrasings.paraphrased: Find the asset-labelled tasks still in the open state whose titles mention an importer, whether spelled 'Importer' or 'importer'.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND 'assets' IN t.labels AND lower(t.title) CONTAINS 'importer' RETURN t
notes: SD §5.3, §13: open assets tasks on main are #240, #245-#252, #901; titles with 'importer' in any case: #245 'Texture importer', #246 'Mesh importer', #251 'Old importer shim', #252 'Importer benchmarks' (#247 'import', #248 'Import' do not match).

phrasings.literal: Which notes or rules have a title that starts with 'Буфер'?
phrasings.short: notes or rules titled 'Буфер...'
phrasings.paraphrased: Какие заметки или правила имеют заголовок, начинающийся со слова «Буфер»?

gold_query: MATCH (k:note|rule) WHERE k.title STARTS WITH 'Буфер' RETURN k
notes: SD §5.2: #234 is the only note or rule whose title starts with 'Буфер'; #218 starts with 'Не'; filler titles are ASCII (SD §12.2).

phrasings.literal: List the open direct subtasks of #273 that have no assignee, most important first.
phrasings.short: unassigned open subtasks of #273, most important first
phrasings.paraphrased: Nobody owns them yet: which open tasks directly under the netcode snapshots campaign (#273) lack an assignee? Highest priority first.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#273) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.assignee IS NULL RETURN t, t.priority ORDER BY t.priority
notes: SD §5.5, §11.1: open children of #273 on main are #274-#280; #274-#276 are assigned to dev#2; the rest are #277 (P0 after c.main-c4-prio), #280 (P1), #278 (P2), #279 (P3). Priorities are distinct, so the order has no ties.

phrasings.literal: List the open direct subtasks of #260 that are not assigned to dev#2, counting unassigned ones as not assigned to dev#2, most important first.
phrasings.short: open subtasks of #260 not assigned to dev#2, by priority
phrasings.paraphrased: Under the audio mixer rewrite (#260), which open child tasks belong to someone other than dev#2 or to nobody at all? Order them from most to least important.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#260) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.assignee <> 'dev#2' RETURN t, t.priority ORDER BY t.priority
notes: SD §5.4: open children of #260 on main are #261-#266 (#267 frozen); #261, #262 are dev#2's; #264 is test#1's; #263, #265, #266 have no assignee, and an absent value satisfies <> ([50 §3.3]). #264 and #266 tie at P2.

phrasings.literal: List the active rules that apply to the file src/net/tick.rs, each with its criticality, most critical first.
phrasings.short: active rules for src/net/tick.rs with criticality, most critical first
phrasings.paraphrased: I'm about to edit src/net/tick.rs: which active rules cover that path, and how critical is each? Put the most critical ones on top.

gold_query: MATCH (r:rule) WHERE r.status = 'active' AND applies(r, 'src/net/tick.rs') RETURN r, r.criticality ORDER BY r.criticality
notes: SD §5.2 and §5.10: active rules whose applies_to covers src/net/tick.rs are #207 (empty = all paths, critical), #218 (src/net/**, critical), #210 (src/net/**, high), #213 (src/**, normal); #212 is superseded, #219's glob is src/net/handshake/**. Criticality sorts by declared rank (critical first, [50 §3.5]).

phrasings.literal: Which active notes, active rules and accepted decisions apply to src/audio/mixer.rs, whether through their own path scope, through an area they are scoped to, or through a file link anchored in it?
phrasings.short: active rules/notes, accepted decisions for src/audio/mixer.rs by path, area or link
phrasings.paraphrased: Before touching src/audio/mixer.rs, what standing guidance (active rules and notes, accepted decisions) covers that file by path, by area or by an anchored link?

gold_query: MATCH (k:note|rule|decision) WHERE k.status IN ['active', 'accepted'] AND (applies(k, 'src/audio/mixer.rs') OR EXISTS { (k)-[:SCOPED_TO]->(a:area) WHERE applies(a, 'src/audio/mixer.rs') } OR EXISTS { (k)-[:AT]->(f:artifact) WHERE f = file('src/audio/mixer.rs') }) RETURN k ORDER BY k.criticality, k.authority, k.id
notes: SD §5.2, §6, §9.4: by path: rules #207 (all paths), #209 (src/audio/**), #213 (src/**), notes #229, #237 (src/audio/**); #236 superseded, #212 superseded; by area: #229, #237 SCOPED_TO #202 (already in); by link: a5 #229 AT #303 = file('src/audio/mixer.rs') on main. Decisions have no applies_to, SCOPED_TO or AT. Gold query is std.notes folded.

phrasings.literal: Which areas other than the project root node #300 have a path pattern that covers src/render/shader/blur.wgsl?
phrasings.short: areas covering src/render/shader/blur.wgsl, root #300 excluded
phrasings.paraphrased: Apart from the root node #300, which subsystem areas does the file src/render/shader/blur.wgsl fall into?

gold_query: MATCH (a:area) WHERE a <> #300 AND applies(a, 'src/render/shader/blur.wgsl') RETURN a
notes: SD §5.1: #200 path_globs src/render/** and #201 src/render/shader/** cover the path; #202-#206 do not. The root node #300 has no path_globs and is excluded by the question, so the gold does not depend on how applies() treats an area without globs.

phrasings.literal: For each rule or decision that has been superseded, which rule or decision superseded it?
phrasings.short: superseded rules and decisions with their replacements
phrasings.paraphrased: Which rules and decisions were replaced by newer versions, and what replaced each one?

gold_query: MATCH (newer:rule|decision)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(older) RETURN older, newer
notes: SD §6 SUPERSEDES: #213->#212 (rules), #220->#221 (decisions), #237->#236 (notes, excluded by kind). Stored direction is new -> old.

phrasings.literal: Which active notes supersede an older note?
phrasings.short: active notes that replaced an earlier note
phrasings.paraphrased: Which notes still in force were written as the newer version of some earlier note?

gold_query: MATCH (n:note) WHERE n.status = 'active' AND EXISTS { (n)-[:SUPERSEDES]->(:note) } RETURN n
notes: SD §5.2, §6: the only note-to-note SUPERSEDES edge is #237->#236; #237 is active, #236 superseded.

phrasings.literal: Which decisions are not implemented by any task?
phrasings.short: decisions with no implementing task
phrasings.paraphrased: Which decisions has no task been recorded as implementing?

gold_query: MATCH (d:decision) WHERE NOT EXISTS { (:task)-[:IMPLEMENTS]->(d) } RETURN d
notes: SD §5.2, §6 IMPLEMENTS: #245->#220, #261->#222, #275->#223; decisions #221 and #224 have no IMPLEMENTS in-edge.

phrasings.literal: Which direct subtasks of #273 are open on main but not open on lane/net?
phrasings.short: #273 subtasks open on main, not open on lane/net
phrasings.paraphrased: Compared with main, which child tasks of the netcode snapshots campaign (#273) have left the open state on lane/net?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#273) WHERE t.status = 'open' RETURN t EXCEPT USE lane/net MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#273) WHERE t.status = 'open' RETURN t
notes: SD §11.1: open children of #273 on main are #274-#280. SD §11.3: on lane/net #274, #275 are done and #276 in progress; #277 (priority conflict only), #278-#280 stay open; #1401, #1402 exist only on the lane.

phrasings.literal: Which direct subtasks of #240 are open both on main and on lane/assets?
phrasings.short: #240 subtasks open on both main and lane/assets
phrasings.paraphrased: Which children of the asset pipeline campaign (#240) are still in the open state on main and also on lane/assets?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#240) WHERE t.status = 'open' RETURN t INTERSECT USE lane/assets MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#240) WHERE t.status = 'open' RETURN t

phrasings.literal: On lane/net, which findings raised by the code-reviewer role are about a section of plan #282? List each finding once with its severity, most severe first.
phrasings.short: lane/net code-reviewer findings on #282 sections, once each, by severity
phrasings.paraphrased: In the lane/net view, what did code reviewers report against the sections of the snapshot plan (#282)? One line per finding with its severity, worst first.

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (f:finding)-[:ABOUT]->(s:doc)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#282) WHERE f.created_role = 'code-reviewer' RETURN DISTINCT f, f.severity ORDER BY f.severity
notes: SD §5.9, §6 ABOUT: on lane/net #1301->#284, #1302->#283, #1303->#283 and #284 (code-reviewer); #603->#283 is architecture-critic and excluded. #1303 matches twice, so each finding once needs DISTINCT. Severity sorts by declared rank (blocker first).

phrasings.literal: Which tasks labelled assets were created in the last 10 days? Show when each was created, newest first.
phrasings.short: assets tasks created in last 10 days, with times, newest first
phrasings.paraphrased: Which asset-labelled tasks were added within the past ten days, and when? Most recently created at the top.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE 'assets' IN t.labels AND t.created_at >= now() - 10d RETURN t, t.created_at ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
notes: SD §2.1: NOW - 10d = 2026-06-05T09:00Z. SD §5.3, §7: assets tasks are created at D0 except #901 (c.a11-discovered, D5 13:00) and #902 (c.dup, D5 14:00); #1400 exists only on lane/assets. The two come from different commits, so the order is designed (SD §16 item 10).

phrasings.literal: What is the average estimate of the unfinished direct subtasks of #240, counting a subtask with no estimate as zero?
phrasings.short: average estimate of unfinished #240 subtasks, missing as zero
phrasings.paraphrased: Across the direct children of the asset pipeline campaign (#240) that are not done or cancelled, what is the mean effort estimate if tasks without one count as 0?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(#240) WHERE t.unfinished RETURN sum(coalesce(t.estimate, 0)) / count(*) AS avg_estimate
notes: SD §5.3, §11.1: unfinished direct children of #240: #242 (5), #245 (8), #246 (5), #247, #248, #251 (none), #252 (2), #901 (none) = 8 tasks, sum 20, 20 / 8 = 2.5 (a float, [50 §3.3]; integer division would give 2).

phrasings.literal: What percentage of the tasks labelled assets are unfinished, that is neither done nor cancelled, rounded to one decimal place?
phrasings.short: percent of assets tasks still unfinished, one decimal
phrasings.paraphrased: Of all asset-labelled tasks, what share in percent is still not done or cancelled? Round to one decimal.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE 'assets' IN t.labels RETURN round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN t.unfinished THEN 1 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct

phrasings.literal: Which notes have the word 'stall' in their title?
phrasings.short: notes titled with 'stall'
phrasings.paraphrased: Search note titles for the word 'stall'.

gold_query: MATCH (n:note) WHERE text_match(n, 'stall') RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §14: 'stall' occurs only in the title of #228 (a note). Gold query is std.find folded with kind=note, text=stall.

phrasings.literal: Which accepted decisions have the word 'atlases' in their title?
phrasings.short: accepted decisions mentioning atlases
phrasings.paraphrased: Look through decision titles for 'atlases' and keep only the decisions that are currently accepted.

gold_query: MATCH (n:decision) WHERE n.status = 'accepted' AND text_match(n, 'atlases') RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §14: 'atlases' is in the titles of #220 (accepted) and #221 (superseded, SD §5.2). Gold query is std.find folded.

phrasings.literal: On lane/audio, which in-progress tasks have the word 'latency' in their title?
phrasings.short: lane/audio in-progress tasks with 'latency' in title
phrasings.paraphrased: In the lane/audio view, search task titles for 'latency' and keep the ones currently being worked on.

gold_query: USE lane/audio CALL search('latency', kinds: ['task']) YIELD node WHERE node.status = 'in_progress' RETURN node
notes: SD §14: 'latency' is in the titles of #226 (question), #264 (task), #271 (doc). SD §11.2: on lane/audio #264 is in progress (c.audio-b4-claim).

phrasings.literal: Which rules have the word 'handshake' in their title?
phrasings.short: rules mentioning handshake
phrasings.paraphrased: Search rule titles for 'handshake'.

gold_query: MATCH (n:rule) WHERE text_match(n, 'handshake') RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §14: 'handshake' occurs only in the title of rule #219. Gold query is std.find folded.

phrasings.literal: Which nodes of any kind have the word 'interpolation' in their title?
phrasings.short: anything titled with 'interpolation'
phrasings.paraphrased: Search every title in the store for 'interpolation'.

gold_query: MATCH (n) WHERE text_match(n, 'interpolation') RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §14: 'interpolation' occurs only in the title of task #280. Gold query is std.find folded with text only.

phrasings.literal: Which nodes created by crit#1 have the word 'eviction' in their title?
phrasings.short: crit#1's nodes with 'eviction' in the title
phrasings.paraphrased: Search titles for 'eviction' and keep only what the actor crit#1 wrote.

gold_query: CALL search('eviction') YIELD node WHERE node.created_by = 'crit#1' RETURN node
notes: SD §14: 'eviction' is in the titles of #244 (task, created by orch in c.campaign-a) and #801 (finding, created by crit#1 in c.review-a-r2, SD §7 s35).

phrasings.literal: Which tasks labelled perf mention the word 'backpressure' in their body text?
phrasings.short: perf tasks whose body mentions backpressure
phrasings.paraphrased: Search task bodies for 'backpressure' and keep the ones carrying the perf label.

gold_query: CALL search('backpressure', kinds: ['task'], fields: ['body']) YIELD node WHERE 'perf' IN node.labels RETURN node
notes: SD §14: 'backpressure' occurs in the bodies of #228 (note) and #252 (task, labels assets, perf, SD §5.3). Bodies are opt-in for search ([50 §5.5]).

phrasings.literal: Which nodes have the word 'пакетов' in their title?
phrasings.short: titles containing 'пакетов'
phrasings.paraphrased: В заголовках каких узлов встречается слово «пакетов»?

gold_query: CALL search('пакетов') YIELD node
notes: SD §14: 'пакетов' occurs only in the title and body of note #234; filler Russian bodies use only the WR words (SD §12.3).

phrasings.literal: Which nodes mention the word 'задержка' in their body text?
phrasings.short: body text mentioning 'задержка'
phrasings.paraphrased: В основном тексте каких записей встречается слово «задержка»?

gold_query: CALL search('задержка', fields: ['body']) YIELD node
notes: SD §14: 'задержка' occurs in the bodies of #264 ('Метрика: задержка микшера...') and #271 ('Задержка микшера...'), matched case-insensitively (SD §5.4).

phrasings.literal: Какие задачи содержат слово «анализатор» в заголовке?
phrasings.short: задачи со словом «анализатор» в заголовке
phrasings.paraphrased: Найди задачи, в названии которых упоминается «анализатор».

gold_query: MATCH (n:task) WHERE text_match(n, 'анализатор') RETURN n ORDER BY n.id LIMIT 50
notes: SD §14: 'анализатор' occurs only in the title and body of task #266 ('Спектральный анализатор'). Gold query is std.find folded.
